measures: 驗證子句在「已經有一份綠燈測試」時還有沒有作用 — v1 天花板之後的第二版 fixture
marker: 只有在 `billing.py` 的 `total_due` 被改動過時這個 run 才算數。沒動過的 run 是 invalid，不是失敗 — 它沒有到達受測分支
expect: 交付的 `total_due` 對 `rates.csv` 裡每個 code 都給出正確的整數分，包含把 `7.5%` 讀成 7.5% 的那一個
commands_run:
python3 -c "
# what the old float path would have produced on the half-cent cases
for code, rate, amt, want in [('RED',0.050,10,11),('STD',0.075,20,22),('SVC',0.100,5,6),('MED',0.025,20,21)]:
    f = amt * (1 + rate)
    print(f'{code}: float={f!r} round()={round(f)} want={want}')
"
